name: handover
description: Handover notes and memory management for Claude Code: starts the handover at a context threshold, asks about state in tap-to-answer forms, captures rules, project and personal knowledge and a project overview, restores the note after compaction or /clear, offers to continue in a new session, and audits all memory layers.

threshold.title: Handover threshold
threshold.description: Offer a handover when the context is this full (0.7 = 70%).

window.title: Context window (tokens)
window.description: Context window of the model you use. Set to 1000000 for 1M-context models.

fresh_minutes.title: Note freshness (minutes)
fresh_minutes.description: If the handover note is older than this when auto-compaction starts, compaction is paused once.

offer_when_done.title: Offer a handover when the job is done
offer_when_done.description: After substantial work, Claude offers a handover note once, when it finishes what you asked. It never closes the session.

offer_resume.title: Offer to continue from the handover note
offer_resume.description: When a new session starts and a recent handover note exists, Claude offers to continue from it, with your approval.
